title: SoBro 1BR | Walk to Broadway & Bridgestone
description:
Stay in the heart of Nashville’s SoBro neighborhood, just an 8–10 minute walk from Broadway! 🎶
This stylish 10th-floor retreat puts you close to the best of Music City while giving you a comfortable place to relax after a day—or night—downtown. 
Perfect for couples, friends, small families, business travelers, and weekend getaways. The space comfortably sleeps up to 4 guests. Permit #T202205662.

The space
Our thoughtfully designed home features:

Private Bedroom with a comfortable queen bed. Living Room featuring a twin trundle sofa bed that converts into 2 twin beds, comfortably accommodating up to 4 guests in the unit. On the 10th floor.

✔️ Fully equipped kitchen 🍽️

✔️ High-speed Wi-Fi 📶

✔️ Smart TV 📺

✔️Dedicated workspace 💻

✔️ Seasonal pool access🏊

✔️ In-unit essentials for a comfortable stay 🧺

✔️  10th-floor city setting🏙️

✔️ Fitness center 💪

Guest access
One of the best parts of this stay is how close you’ll be to Nashville’s most popular attractions.

Approximate walking distance:

🎸 Broadway – 8–10 minutes
🏒 Bridgestone Arena – 10 minutes
🎶 Country Music Hall of Fame – 8–10 minutes
🎤 Music City Center – nearby
🍽 Restaurants, bars & entertainment – minutes away

Leave the car behind and experience downtown Nashville on foot.

Whether you’re coming for a concert, girls’ trip, couples getaway, sporting event, convention, family trip, or simply a weekend in Music City, you’ll have easy access to the action while staying just outside the busiest part of Broadway.

🏠 YOUR HOME AWAY FROM HOME

Come back after exploring Nashville and unwind in a comfortable, modern space designed to make your stay easy and enjoyable.

Please note: Complimentary parking is not included with the reservation. Paid parking options are available in the surrounding downtown/SoBro area.

Hosted by SweetStay Escapes. We look forward to welcoming you to Nashville! 🤎

Other things to note
🚭 Strict No-Smoking Policy: Smoking or evidence of smoking anywhere inside the unit is prohibited. A $500 smoking fee will be charged if evidence of smoking is found during or after your stay.

🔑 Key Fob: Lost or unreturned key fobs will incur a $300 replacement fee.

🛠️ Damages: Guests are responsible for any damage beyond normal wear and tear. Repair or replacement costs will be professionally assessed and charged to the reservation holder.

Please help us care for our home so every guest can enjoy the same exceptional experience.

We look forward to hosting you and making your Nashville stay unforgettable!
